parts.text: Name three historical places connected with the story of the life of Jesus.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Briefly describe what happened to Jesus at one of these places.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why believers might visit Christian historical places.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Not all Christian historical places are of equal importance to believers.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
‘But when you pray, go into your room.’
Matthew 6:6 [NIV]

parts.label: (i)

parts.text: Explain the importance of the Bible to Christians.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Christians should pray only to Jesus.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section answer all the questions.
3 (a) (i) Give three things known about the early life of Muhammad (pbuh).

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Briefly describe Muhammad’s (pbuh) character in his early life.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Muhammad (pbuh) was persecuted in Makkah.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Muslims need the Sunnah (Ahadith) to be able to follow the Qur’an.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

Surah 29:45

‘The rituals of prayer are more important than the words.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.
